component.name: backchat
component.summary: Bluetooth mesh chat with IRC vibes

description.p: backchat is a Linux client for the bitchat protocol: serverless chat over a Bluetooth LE mesh. Messages hop peer to peer with a short time to live, so the room works with no internet at all; geohash channels and private messages ride Nostr relays when there is one.
Wire compatible with the upstream bitchat iOS and Android clients: join the same room as nearby phones without an account, a server, or a phone number.
First aarch64 release: Linux phones and ARM laptops install the same listing as x86_64. Mesh vocabulary unified across the client, radio logging calmed.
First packaging: BLE mesh dual-role radio, geohash channels, private messages, and the people-rail client.
